findings.evidence: The execution summary explicitly separates planned cases from actual results and requires environment/build/evidence before a Pass or Fail status.
findings.why_it_matters: A test plan must not be mistaken for runtime sign-off.
findings.required_action: No blocking action; fill the template only when a real run supplies evidence.

findings.evidence: Cases cover negative, authorization, duplicate/conflict, offline/retry, provider failure, Proctor audit, score readiness, and publication visibility paths.
findings.why_it_matters: The highest-risk business invariants need explicit failure-path evidence.
findings.required_action: No blocking action; execute or mark blocked with a dependency in later test runs.

findings.evidence: PTE Academic certification, Student self-payment, mobile delivery, advanced anti-cheat, and provider quality guarantees are explicitly excluded.
findings.why_it_matters: Test scope cannot be inflated by treating excluded product behavior as a missing test.
findings.required_action: No blocking action; retain the boundary in later reports.
